name: Tamil Nadu Wind Farm
description: By supporting this project you can help to phase down fossil fuels. The Tamil Nadu Wind Farm Project will displace clean and affordable electricity to the Indian grid, which would otherwise have been generated by fossil fuel sources. The project will replace anthropogenic emissions of greenhouse gases, estimated to be 7,07,799 tonnes of CO2 over a period of 10 years.

name: Rimba Raya
description: The Rimba Raya Project creates a buffer zone right next to Tanjung Puting National Park to stop planned deforestation that involves the removal of trees for oil palm plantations.

name: Al-Zorah Natural Reserve Mangroves
description: The Al Zorah Nature Reserve is an inland creek that extends over 2 square kilometres of biologically and ecologically rich wetland. Home to a fish nursery, the creek and mangrove are designated as conservation areas. In July 2017, they were declared as "wetlands of global importance" under the Ramsar Convention.
